body: The author answered B, K and O through Ziggy (two screenshots of his replies, shown in chat this afternoon) and added, unasked, that John's car is a present-day unmarked performance sedan and that marked cruisers are SUVs now. In substance: present day with smartphones; Massachusetts State Police for the uniforms and John's team, the agents FBI as the script has them; the whole screenplay as one film, which answers the card's own question. Recorded in the interview file (answers B, K, O, S in the Hon form) and the decisions record; Addendum A applies them to the set round; card delta v2 (after v1) marks the four answered, adds two follow-ups (B-f1 the trace question the author raised himself; S-f1 sedan or SUV) and links the addendum. Fifteen questions stay outstanding; N is next. Not applied by the writer.
